dates.event: Last Date for Receipt of Application

howToApply: Fill the application on plain paper in the prescribed format, completely and correctly, and sign it.
Affix one recent passport size photograph at the designated place on the application form and self-attest it.

Attach self-attested photocopies of: Age proof, Address proof, Indian Citizenship proof, Educational Qualification, Technical Qualification (ITI etc.), HMV Driving Licence/Licence Extract (for MV Mechanic only), One year trade experience certificate with full postal address of organization, SC/ST/OBC(NCL)/ESM Certificate issued by Competent Authority, and two self-attested passport size photographs.
Submit separate applications for each trade if applying for multiple trades.
Superscribe the trade applied for on the envelope.
Send the application through Speed Post only to: The Senior Manager, Mail Motor Services, 139, Beleghata Main Road, Kolkata-700015.
Ensure the application is received on or before 30/11/2026 by 17:00 Hours.
Do not send original certificates; send only self-attested copies.

title: IRCON Recruitment 2026 – Manager (Walk-in) Posts
shortInfo: IRCON has announced notification for Manager (Walk-in) posts. Required qualification: B.Tech / B.E. Last date to apply: 19,.
howToApply: Candidates should ensure they fulfill all eligibility criteria before reporting for Walk-in Interview.
Register at the respective venue as per the schedule (Registration starts at 09:30 AM, closes at 1:00 PM).

Bring one set of photocopies along with originals of: Application typed on A-4 size paper in the prescribed format, Experience Certificates in chronological order (with last two months’ salary slip for present employment), Date of Birth/Class X passing certificate, Caste/EWS/Age relaxation certificate (in prescribed GoI format), Qualification Degree/Diploma and all semester/year mark sheets.
OBC candidates must bring a caste certificate issued in the current financial year as proof of not belonging to the creamy layer.
Candidates with CGPA/OGPA/DGPA should bring a conversion certificate from their university/institute if applicable.
No request for change of date, time, or location will be entertained.
For queries, email: recruitment@ircon.org
